lines.text: Little Mermaid holds out a bubble to Mihara.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: With this, I shall recreate those precious to you.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: If you describe them to me,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: then I'll shape them as closely as I can.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Hmm, okay. I suppose the obvious first choice would be...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Yuni?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Hehe, I thought you'd say that!
Little Mermaid closes her eyes and imbues the bubble with her Kotodama.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: A face resembling Yuni's.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Transform.
The bubble begins to glow and change shape.
After a few moments, it takes the shape of Yuni's face, complete with a hood and mask.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: It really does look like Yuni!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Fascinating.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Do you like it?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I love it!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Hehe, I'm glad to hear that.
Little Mermaid grabs a new bubble.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Who should I make next?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: You.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah uh?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Make one of you for me.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: You said you used them to recreate people who you trust and hold dear.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: So make me one of you.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah, ah uh ah...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Haha, why are you so flustered?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I-I don't know what to say.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... I'm touched.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Given everything you've done for us here, it's only natural, don't you think?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... Even so. Thank you for trusting me, Mihara.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I should be the one thanking you for cheering me up.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Hehe. Well then, I'll go ahead and make one for you.
Little Mermaid closes her eyes, and by the time they open,
the bubbles have assumed the look and shape of her own face.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: It's just as fascinating the second time around.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh, ooh uh...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Are you still feeling self-conscious?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: A little...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Haha, then why don't we move onto the next one?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Aooh!
Little Mermaid proceeds to create a new bubble. This one is of...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Hehe, even like this, Mori still looks adorable.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Hehe. Ooh!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Let's show this to her later.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: She'll get a kick out of it.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Sure.
It's Mori.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: An intelligent researcher with short hair and glasses.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Seems cold at first, but she's really warm and kind.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Yes, that's it!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Are you sure that's all the information you need?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Hmm... This is my first time doing this, so I may need to make a few adjustments afterward.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Let me give it a try first.
Little Mermaid closes her eyes, then opens them.
A woman with short hair, sharp eyes, and glasses takes form.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Wow, it's quite similar.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I thought about Abe, and made it in a similar image.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I'm glad it worked out.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Let's change the glasses to semi-rimless ones,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: slim down the face a bit, and give her sharper eyebrows.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: No problem.
It's Mana.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: She's about Mori's age and wears ribbons in her short, wavy hair,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: along with long triangular earrings.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Oh, and she has subtle highlights in her bangs.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Her eyes tilt downward ever so slightly, and there's a mole under her left eye.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: As for her personality, she's... arrogant. Stubborn. Often has an acid tongue.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... Someone like that mean this much to you?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Yes, she does. Her words may be vitriolic, but deep down, there's a tender side to her.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: And more than anything, she's cute.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Who is she?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: The one who made me.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Hehe. I guess you can't help but be fond of the person who made you.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: That's right. I like her.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: ... Even though she might not feel the same way about me.
Little Mermaid proceeds to create a bubble version of Syuen.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Wow, you're better at this than I expected!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Now I'm wondering who to make next...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: It's fine even if it's a face you just want to see again. It could be anyone.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Faces that I want to see again...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: It's a girl with long hair down to her hips,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: with ribbons on both sides.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Her eyebrows angle downward a bit more than Syuen's, and she has an extremely gentle face.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Oh, and there's this adorable little mole just below the left side of her mouth.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: She has a face that's made for smiling.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: As for her personality... she's like an innocent child, prone to blind devotion.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: That sounds like Yuni, hehe.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I know, right?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Okay. I'll try.
Little Mermaid embraces a bubble and closes her eyes,
and the face of a girl with long, ribboned hair appears.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: ... Yes. That's her.
Mihara gently caresses the girl's face.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I never thought I would see her again.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: She must be someone you care deeply about.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Yes. She's very precious to me.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: It's the old Yuni.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... So this is what she looked like.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: ... Yes.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I only had a vague memory of her myself,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: so this is the first time I've seen it clearly.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Vague memory? How's that possible?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I had my memory wiped.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: A memory wipe? What's that?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Oh, right. Since you're not from the Ark, you might not know.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Well, to put it simply, it's a special process that resets a Nikke's memories

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: back to how they were when they were first rolled out.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I didn't even know that was possible.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: So I don't have any memories of my past.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: My memories of Yuni are nothing but brief flashes. Fleeting images.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: If I want anything more than that, I have to depend on recordings.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: So that's why...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: It's still nice to see her like this.
Mihara stares continually at Yuni's face.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Despite that, I think it would be best to get rid of this one.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Woo?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: If Yuni sees this, she might get sad.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... I understand.
What was once Yuni's face turns back into an amorphous, nondescript bubble.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Thanks, Siren.
Mihara looks at the faces of her friends made from the bubbles.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: You're right, Siren. Being surrounded by the faces of people I love...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: It makes me feel like I'm not alone.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I feel better.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Hehe, glad to hear it.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Shall I make more for you?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Let's see...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Maybe it has something to do with my memory being wiped not too long ago, but no one comes to mind...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Did someone come to mind?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Yes. There is someone I'd like to remember.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Even just a fleeting thought of them makes me miss them so much...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: How much I long to see them again...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Would you like me to make them?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Hmm... I'm not sure if I can describe them.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: My memory is too faint and I don't even remember their face properly.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Hmm... If I don't have any description to go on, it might be a little hard to recreate them.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Darn, that's too bad.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: If it comes to mind later, I'll ask you then.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I wonder if there's any way...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: There is a way, but it might be dangerous.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I can use my Kotodama.
